title: Flyer and Schedule

sections.alt: Ladies’ Day flyer: Newport Harbor LBC, 1550 Crown Dr, Corona del Mar, Wednesday, April 8, 2026, check-in 9:00 a.m. All women bowlers welcome; wear whites or club shirts with collars; bring a lunch, salads provided; entry fee $5.00.

2026 Ladies Day schedule: Apr 8 Newport Harbor, May 13 Long Beach, Jun 10 Hermosa Beach, Jul 8 Newport Harbor, Aug 12 Laguna Beach, Sept 9 Santa Ana, Oct 14 Casta Del Sol, Nov 11 The Groves, and Tues Dec 15 Laguna Woods holiday luncheon in Clubhouse 2.
